Our Culture & Values
Office-first culture
At Formalize, we believe in building teams of people who fundamentally prefer to work together in person in an office, sharing knowledge, spending time with each other, and appreciating being physically connected to other people during the workday. This doesn’t mean that people cannot work from home, but each team, in agreement with their respective manager, has its work-from-home policy.
Our Values
You Thrive with Ambition
You’re motivated by ambition and strive for exceptional results. You love to grow professionally and personally. You demand greatness from yourself and others.
You Strive For Impact Through Pragmatism
Execution is key: you get stuff done and relentlessly pursue impactful outcomes. You meet problems with pragmatic solutions to create impact for customers and stakeholders. You stay flexible and proactive as priorities shift and the company grows.
You Are Passionate and Honest
You celebrate wins enthusiastically, and share mistakes as fuel for growth. You give colleagues honest feedback, challenge them constructively, because you respect them. You proactively share knowledge and foster a culture of teamwork.
Our Products
Formalize
Automates compliance workflows with an easy-to-use and customizable compliance platform.
Whistleblower Software
For companies to comply with EU whistleblowing laws and save time with a system that is secure, customizable and easy to use
The story behind Formalize
From Whistleblower Software to Formalize
Our journey started within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story.
This initial chapter has been within whistleblowing compliance and meeting those regulations. Along the way we established strong partnerships and a base of satisfied customers. Our commitment was recognized through the best customer support, which earned us reputation as a customer-centric pioneer. But now, we extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe including data compliance, risk and privacy.
Formalize helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet, and foresee, the evolving needs of our users - ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.
